scope: Bind one hash-identified physical AC1032 RASTERVARIABLES frame=1 source record to a locally authored same-version wrapper, then qualify selected ASCII/Binary output, refusal/retry and typed readback. This does not qualify whole-drawing conversion or native raster behavior.

physicalWitness.provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored an R2010 DXF from scratch with one LINE and RASTERVARIABLES frame=1, quality=1, units=3. ODA File Converter 27.1 produced the AC1032 DWG and a returned DXF; the observed conversion lineage is not authenticated by hashes alone. No sample fixture was added to the repository.
physicalWitness.independentPeer: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 reports custom class/type 512, handle 0x2F, frame=1, quality=1, units=3, class version 0, one role-4 owner and one role-4 reactor to physical NOD 0x0A, and a 14-byte body. ezdxf independently observes the same scalar values in the input and ODA-returned DXF.
physicalWitness.sourceSpan: The source-bound in-tree probe verifies the scalar body ends at bit 73: canonical 10-bit BS frame value 1 occupies [42,52), quality and units follow, the no-string marker is at bit 72, role-4 owner/reactor handles to 0x0A occupy [73,105), and seven trailing pad bits are zero. Page extraction and CRC verification use libdxfrw and are not independent of this repository's reader.

implementation: The physical AC1032 frame=1 test selector now checks the exact versioned source byte/bit span, typed values, NOD entry and owner/reactor roles. It seeds a local AC1032 wrapper with the captured fields while remapping the source NOD owner/reactor 0x0A to wrapper NOD 0x0C, then sends the wrapper through selected ASCII/Binary output.

validation.results: Both physical AC1032 frame selectors passed, and the four focused AC1024/AC1032 generated CTests passed. The frame=1 selected wrapper exercises ASCII/Binary invalid-value and graph-reference refusal with destination preservation, same-adapter correction/retry, and typed readback. Source hashes were unchanged after execution.

limits: The source was locally authored and converted by one ODA version; this is not broad producer coverage.
The physical file retains unrelated HEADER integrity observations. Whole-file strict export remains refused and was not qualified by the selected wrapper.
No native image rendering or other consumer behavior is established.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added; the witness remains in scratch storage.
